reviews.text: A beautiful park, with benches and games for children.

with Italian football now dead and buried... you can still find real football, on the pitch in the park on Via Tieri... MI BERMANO ESTAMO AQUI, true talents, promising footballers, and I, the worst goalkeeper in Rome, if you want football... come to Via Tieri in the late afternoon... you won't regret it.
Beautiful park, one of the best kept in northern Rome

Well-maintained and equipped with a gym; they've finally added WELL-MADE children's equipment and even a nice multi-purpose sports field. It's lit at night. Wild boars are easy to encounter here, so be extremely careful. If you encounter one (whether you have a dog with you or not), try to walk away calmly to avoid upsetting the wild animal. AVOID feeding them, as has become a reckless practice among residents in other areas of the neighborhood!!! While you might think you're doing them a favor, you don't want to realize that they are wild animals and must be treated as such to avoid unpleasant incidents.

It should be noted that the Via Tieri Committee does a lot to maintain the park.

Respecting common areas is an asset for everyone!
Well equipped, shame about the mosquitoes which are in the thousands
